name: SpiderMonk
summary:
Become the city's own hero. SpiderMonk puts you in the body of a web-slinging monkey in a city that never ends. Move the way you'd expect a monkey to: push off the ground and walls with your arms to run, jump and climb, then fire a web and swing between skyscrapers at full speed.

Gangs are robbing the streets, so punch, dodge and counter with your own hands and wrap thugs up in webs. Online rooms let you play with friends in modes including casual free roam, Venom Tag, PvP, Coin Rush and Floor Is Lava, and coins collected across the city can be spent on suits, hats and other cosmetics.
